## Welcome

This is the daily dashboard.

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 400

library(shiny)
library(bslib)

ui <- page_fluid(
  h2("Hello Shinylive"),
  sliderInput("obs", "Number of observations:",
              min = 0, max = 1000, value = 500
  ),
  plotOutput("distPlot")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    hist(rnorm(input$obs))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
